### Simple, family‑friendly menu you can bring this Sunday

You already have many of the core ingredients from the **vegetarian‑friendly weekly dinner plan** (see [[summaries/session-13_2024-06-13]]) – bell pepper, zucchini, fresh spinach, chickpeas, garlic, onion, lemon, and pantry staples (olive oil, salt, pepper). Using those, you can assemble a **One‑Pan Veggie‑&‑Chickpea Skillet** plus a quick side salad and fresh fruit dessert.

#### 1️⃣ Main – One‑Pan Veggie & Chickpea Skillet  
*(adapted from the Thursday “Veggie + Chickpea Skillet” recipe in the weekly plan)*  

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1️⃣ | Heat **2 Tbsp olive oil** in a large skillet over medium heat. |
| 2️⃣ | Add **½ small yellow onion** (thinly sliced) and **1 clove garlic**, sauté 2‑3 min until fragrant. |
| 3️⃣ | Toss in the **½ bell pepper** (julienned) and **½ small zucchini** (sliced). Cook 4‑5 min until they start to soften. |
| 4️⃣ | Add the **1 can chickpeas** (drained & rinsed). Sprinkle with **½ tsp salt, ¼ tsp pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice**. Stir and cook another 3‑4 min so the chickpeas heat through and the veggies are tender‑crisp. |
| 5️⃣ | Finish with a handful of **fresh spinach**; toss until wilted (≈1 min). Serve hot with a side of **cooked rice** or warm **tortillas** (both already on your grocery list). |

*Why it works:* High‑protein vegetarian, uses the same vegetables you already buy for the week, and needs only a single pan → minimal cleanup for a relaxed Sunday.

#### 2️⃣ Side – Simple Lemon‑Garlic Green Salad  
- Mix any leftover **spinach** with a drizzle of **olive oil**, a splash of **lemon juice**, a pinch of **salt & pepper**, and thinly sliced **remaining bell pepper** for color and crunch.

#### 3️⃣ Dessert – Fresh Seasonal Fruit  
- Grab a couple of **apples** or **oranges** from the pantry staples (or whatever fruit you have on hand). Slice and serve with a dollop of **plain yogurt** (optional) for a light finish.
